content.question: Match cross-validation strategies with their descriptions.

answer.K-fold cross-validation: The model is trained on N − 1 folds and validated on the remaining one; this is repeated N times, so each fold serves as the validation set exactly once.
answer.Leave-p-out cross-validation: In each iteration, N samples are held out as the validation set, and the model is trained on the remaining data.
answer.Chain cross-validation: Iteratively trained on a growing subset of data and validated on the next data record.
answer.Sliding window cross-validation: After each iteration, the train and test window is moved forward by a fixed number of time steps.
